CC: The duration of Control-Effects like slow, chill, stun, freeze can be prolongued by Baron's 2pc and your Potency Stat . these durations are colored yellow in the table
DOT: The duration of Damage-over-time effects of Legendary Gems can also be prolongued by Baron's 2pc and your Potency Stat these durations are colored yellow in the table
Debuff: The duration of debuffs (Vulnerability, Armorbreak) caused by legendary Gems can also be prolongued by 2pc Baron's and your Potency stat and is colored yellow in the table.
Strife: Usually Legendary Gem Effects are strifed by 70% in Battlegrounds. But there are some exceptions.

you can use already upgraded gems as fodder - just be careful that you do not crunch one of your gems by accident

column2: When you extract Gem Power your Gem becomes dormant. However you can still socket it. It will re-awaken with all its effects when the Resonance Gems
inside the Gem are filled with equal or more Gem Power than the now dormant Gem had before
The "new" Resonance of the Gem is:
Original Resonance of the Ranked Gem (e.g. 1000 for a R10 5/5)
Reduced Resonance of the Resonance Gems (e.g. 2 per Rank for a 2-Star and 10 per Rank for a 5-Star)
Additional Resonance ( = Gem Power of all socketed Resonance Gems / 200). This only works with R10 5* Gems

column2: you can upgrade your legendary gems at the Apprentice Jeweler in Westmarch or any other safe zone (or in castle cyrangar)
all you need to upgrade a Legendary Gem is the Gem itself, some Gem Power and (depending on the upgrade level) some more Rank 1 copies of the Legendary Gem.
Legendary Gems can now be upgraded in smaller increments. Starting at Rank 4, Legendary Gems receive smaller incremental upgrades when combining each
